notes: “The first 5 seconds should go” now removes those 5 seconds, where before it kept only them. Asking for the audio as a WAV, FLAC, AIFF, Apple Lossless, Opus, OGG or WMA file now gives you that file instead of an MP3, and the audio Format menu lists them all. “Zoom in 2x” now crops instead of upscaling, “sped it up 2x” changes the speed, and “make a black and white gif” makes the GIF in black and white. And a “please” beside your request no longer gets “I didn’t catch an edit”.
